source.label: Functional killer transfer below half the holes

reviewer: Claude Code with sole fresh-context medium reviewer

claims.summary: Admissible numbering transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: if a set F of monomial errors with K+|E|<=D has one numbering of pigeons and holes in which, for every matching E in F and every dance-admissible x_t in T_K cap B_K (Impagliazzo-Pudlak-Sgall basis) with t cup E a matching, x_{t cup E} is in B_D, then the common kernel of the x_E in V_K modulo C equals the common kernel modulo H plus C cap V_K. Equivalently the IPS projection R satisfies R(x_E r) = x_E r modulo H on its image.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer in two follow-ups; the criterion is sufficient, not necessary, and needs the union of the errors' hole sets to miss a hole.
claims.rationale: Gives the joint transfer conjectures for any error set with one admissible numbering, a sufficient condition.
claims.next_action: Numbering search for the chain, shared and diagonal sets at 6x5.

claims.summary: Functional killer transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: for every set E of variables and K+|E|<=D, Ann_C(x_E) cap V_K = Ann_H(x_E) cap V_K + (C cap V_K). For N >= 2 the numbering with the holes of E lowest and its pigeons last in a chain order is admissible; N = 1 is checked directly.
claims.assessment: Working proof checked against IPS ECCC TR97-042 pages 3-6 by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with two follow-ups; m > N and N >= 2 were dropped at its finding that no step uses them (more general).
claims.rationale: Proves the single-error parts of conj:functional-kernel-transfer and conj:monomial-kernel-transfer in the basis range, at every K, over every field, for every number of pigeons.
claims.next_action: Joint sets without nested hole sets.

claims.summary: Nested hole joint transfer: over any field, for the functional pigeonhole system (Booleanity, hole and functionality axioms, pigeon axioms Q_i = 1 - sum_j x_ij, multilinear ring) with any number m of pigeons and N >= 1 holes, D <= ceil(N/2), C the degree-D PC closure of all axioms and H that of the hole and functionality axioms alone: for a set F of matchings whose hole sets form a chain under inclusion, with pigeon set Pi, if for each E in F K+|E|<=D and K+2|E|+min(|Pi|-|E|,K)<=N, then the joint transfer of lem:admissible-numbering-transfer holds. Covers the crossing set {x00x11, x01x10} at 6 pigeons, 5 holes, K=1, and every same-hole variable set at K=1 there; at K=2 only same-hole sets with |Pi|<=2. The room condition is a bookkeeping bound.
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, who checked the room count per error; the room condition is a bookkeeping bound.
claims.rationale: Supplies admissible numberings for nested-hole families with room.
claims.next_action: Weaker room using vacated holes of E.

claims.summary: Exhaustive check (numberings.py, exact dance-existence search) on the functional pigeonhole board with 6 pigeons and 5 holes at K=1, D=3: the error sets {x00x11,x11x22} (holes ordered 1,0,2,3,4, pigeons 0,3,4,5,1,2), {x00x11,x00x22} (holes 0..4, pigeons 3,4,5,1,2,0) and {x00x11,x22x33} (holes 0..4, pigeons 3,2,1,0,4,5) satisfy the property of lem:admissible-numbering-transfer, so their joint transfer holds there over every field; the triple {x00x11,x22x33,x34x43} has the property under none of the 86400 numberings, as a count fixes in advance (its hole sets cover all five holes, so some error has a pigeon at the top hole, which cannot dance; the property needs the union of hole sets to miss a hole), although check:block-pair-kernels found its excess 0 over F_2, so the criterion is not necessary. Controls: the crossing set with the corollary's numbering passes; {x04x13} under the identity fails.
claims.assessment: Exact search; code, encodings and controls read by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer, who did not rerun it and supplied the top-hole count for the triple.
claims.rationale: Decides three recorded sets by the criterion and shows its limit on the fourth.
claims.next_action: Joint transfer for the triple by combining numberings.
